|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Behind Everything]] (version 2 of 2). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 27 release sheet (PDF created 13 October 2026), cut unchanged from page 1. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”; file created 13 October 2026). While Sidious alone on Coruscant, he adds one [Dark Side] icon and one [Light Side] icon there. While your apprentice in battle, Blast The Door, Kid! and It's A Trap! may not be played and, once per battle, may choose a player to activate 1 Force. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Behind Everything]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Behind Everything]] (published 19 August 2026) as a printable slip under the label “•Behind Everything”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings).
